scope: native interface and callback admission only; no financial Backtesting.start

source_parameters.target: neckline at confirmation plus/minus head height
source_parameters.crossing: strict > or <; touches do not exit

policy.entry: market on first next-1h open; source signal/tag on confirmation bar; native shifts once
policy.late_entry: reject any timestamp other than exact first entry boundary
policy.reentry: same source event cannot be reused; an approved entry is consumed
policy.overlap: ignore event when same pair already has a position; do not replace original trade metadata
policy.same_clock_reverse: reject events when pair had a position at loop start or closed one at same clock
policy.same_pair_same_bar_dual_event: reject ambiguity, no direction priority selection
policy.self_terminal: retain all event IDs; explicitly mask known zero-duration events as flat
policy.event_binding: trade.enter_tag selects immutable original event stop/target/expiry
policy.source_exit: strict completed 1h close crossing only, expiry break_i+head_width-1
policy.callback_clock: only date+1h<=current_time; source exit fills at next native allowed 5m open
policy.native_catastrophe: -99% hard stop and native liquidation remain separate exit types
policy.errors: entry callback returns False on errors; invalid exit binding gets separate hs_policy_error_exit; any callback error invalidates a future financial run
policy.read_only_prehistory: prepend only frozen dates before native frame, derive exact v1 recognition anew
